name: cross-session-memory-bridge
description: Native AgentBook version control and continuity infrastructure for agent work.

interface.longDescription: Checkpoint, resume, compare, and audit agent work across sessions. AgentBook preserves intent, evidence, decisions, tests, and provenance while Git remains authoritative for files.
defaultPrompt: Show AgentBook status for this project before we change anything.
Checkpoint this work with its Git identity, evidence, risks, and next action.
Run one evidence-backed game-development iteration and record whether to keep or revert it.
